concepts.name: Walking-Beam Pin Stepper
concepts.mechanism_family: Alternating walking-beam lift with roller entry and top pusher
concepts.scoring_sequence: Floor rollers draw in a lying Pin; alternating toothed beams support and step it upward, while a top cross-roller turns it upright and a short pusher slides it onto the Goal.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: Two oscillating ladder beams alternately capture and raise the object through discrete guarded stages rather than carrying it in one carriage.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Approximate tooth spacing and beam phasing needed to retain both Pins and Cups during each hand-off.

concepts.name: Shoulder-Slide Cup Tongs
concepts.mechanism_family: Luffing shoulder with telescoping rack boom and opposed cup tongs
concepts.scoring_sequence: A low compliant mouth centers an upright or tilted Cup, the opposed tongs close below its rim, the shoulder raises it, and the nested boom extends for controlled release above a Goal.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: A powered shoulder supplies height while a rack-driven telescoping boom independently supplies reach; the object is retained by rim tongs rather than a tray.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Tong geometry and compliance required to accommodate approximate Cup and Pin flange profiles without binding.

concepts.name: Skew-Roller Spiral Tower
concepts.mechanism_family: Counter-rotating skew-roller chimney with top placement gate
concepts.scoring_sequence: A wide floor throat captures a lying Pin or Cup; lower rollers center it, successive opposing skew rollers rotate and advance it upward, and a hinged top gate guides the emerging object onto the selected Goal.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: Helical surface motion from angled rollers both orients and elevates the object continuously, without a lift carriage, bucket chain, or conveyor belt.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Roller skew angle and surface compliance needed to generate upward travel without ejecting irregularly oriented objects.

concepts.name: Inverting Yoke Goal Capper
concepts.mechanism_family: Large-radius rotary yoke with split scoop and retention hoop
concepts.scoring_sequence: The open front surrounds a lying Cup or Pin, split rollers pull it into the scoop, and the side-driven yoke rotates the retained object over the robot into an upright, downward placement pose above a Goal.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: One open yoke deliberately inverts the captured object through a broad arc, using gravity against a retention hoop to convert floor orientation into top-down placement.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Clearance between the rotating object, chassis opening, and Goal across the approximate object dimensions.

concepts.name: Cartesian Goal-Side Gantry
concepts.mechanism_family: Overhead longitudinal gantry with rack-lowered expanding gripper
concepts.scoring_sequence: A front funnel and centering rollers stage an upright object between the pods; the overhead carriage travels forward, lowers an internal expanding gripper, lifts the object vertically, traverses beyond the bumper, and lowers it onto a Goal.
concepts.distinguishing_idea: Independent horizontal and vertical Cartesian axes approach the object and Goal from above while the chassis remains clear around the staging bay.
concepts.main_uncertainty: Required mast stiffness and gripper expansion range for stable top-down handling at the highest approximate Goal.
